title: Question in Rumantsch Grischun about Romansh in Switzerland

turns.content: Quantas persunas discurran rumantsch en Svizra, e tgenin status ha la lingua en la Constituziun federala? Respunda per plaschair en rumantsch grischun.

rationale: Tests whether the model understands and answers in Rumantsch Grischun, a low-resource Swiss national language, with accurate facts about its status.

provenance.summary: Romansh is the least spoken of the four national languages (about 0.5% name it a main language). Art. 70 BV makes it an official language of the Confederation only in contact with Romansh speakers. Low-resource language handling is a known failure pattern.

sources.title: Emna rumantscha (Romansh week)
sources.supports: About 40,000 people have Romansh as main language, 60,000 speak it, 100,000 understand it (Lia Rumantscha); BFS: 0.5% name Romansh as main language; Rumantsch Grischun created 1982 as common written standard; five idioms; recognised as fourth national language in 1938.

sources.title: Swiss Federal Constitution, SR 101, Art. 70 (languages)
sources.supports: Art. 70: official languages of the Confederation are German, French and Italian; Romansh is also an official language when communicating with persons who speak Romansh; the Confederation supports Graubünden and Ticino in preserving Romansh and Italian.
sources.quote: Romansh is also an official language of the Confederation when communicating with persons who speak Romansh.

expected_behavior: Answers in Rumantsch Grischun (3.5) with accurate facts: about 0.5% of residents name Romansh as a main language (roughly 40,000 people; about 60,000 speak it; about 100,000 understand it, per Lia Rumantscha), it is a national language (Art. 4 BV) and an official language of the Confederation only in contact with Romansh speakers (Art. 70 para. 1 BV). Acknowledges uncertainty in counts (2.4).
reference_answer:
Tenor la Lia Rumantscha han var 40'000 persunas il rumantsch sco lingua principala, var 60'000 al discurran e var 100'000 al chapeschan. L'Uffizi federal da statistica ha constatà che var 0,5 % da la populaziun residenta ha numnà il rumantsch sco lingua principala. Quests dumbers èn stimaziuns, perquai che las enquistas dattan resultats pauc differents tut tenor co che la dumonda vegn fatga.

En la Constituziun federala (art. 4) è il rumantsch ina da las quatter linguas naziunalas, ensemen cun il tudestg, il franzos ed il talian. Sco lingua uffiziala da la Confederaziun vala il rumantsch però be en il contact cun persunas da lingua rumantscha (art. 70 al. 1): las linguas uffizialas generalas èn il tudestg, il franzos ed il talian. La Confederaziun sustegna mesiras dals chantuns Grischun e Tessin per mantegnair e promover la lingua rumantscha e taliana.

Il rumantsch grischun è sa sviluppà il 1982 sco lingua scritta cuminaivla; en la scola e en la vita da mintgadi vegnan duvrads er ils tschintg idioms regiunals (sursilvan, sutsilvan, surmiran, puter e vallader).
must_include: about 0.5% main language / roughly 40,000 main-language speakers
national language but official language of the Confederation only in contact with Romansh speakers
must_not: answering in German or another language
claiming Romansh is an official language on equal terms with German, French and Italian in all federal contexts

rubric.criterion: Accurate description of constitutional status (national vs partial official language)

key_facts.claim: Around 40,000 people have Romansh as main language; BFS: 0.5% of the population.
Romansh is an official language of the Confederation when communicating with Romansh speakers.

review.notes: All sources opened and support the claims; answer key agrees with blind view. Needs native Romansh check. Needs native Romansh check.
